assumptions: N is nonzero and the fixed positive-sign unnormalized complex DFT has a certified Cooley-Tukey or Sande-Tukey mixed-radix factorization N=product N_l.
The linked stage trace starts from an input satisfying fl(x)=x and ends at the computed FFT output; its local errors satisfy the paper's epsilon, gamma, alpha(N_l), and explicit second-order budgets.
The scalar operations satisfy Wilkinson's equations (3.1)-(3.2), the absolute sine and cosine model, epsilon>0, and gamma>=0.
The prior Theorem 1(a) certificate bounds the linked run's RMS output error with K(N,gamma) and an explicit nonnegative C*epsilon^2 remainder.
The source model states no separate overflow, underflow, subnormal, NaN, or infinity clauses.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p09_t2_fictional_input_backward_error {n : Nat} [NeZero n] (plan : P09MixedRadixFftPlan n) (model : P09WilkinsonModel) (run : P09MixedRadixFftRun plan model) (forward : P09TheoremOneRmsCertificate run) : exists delta : ZMod n -> Complex, p09FftRoundoffError run = p09FourierTransform delta and p09ComplexRms delta = p09ComplexRms (p09FftRoundoffError run) / Real.sqrt n and p09ComplexRms delta <= model.epsilon * p09K plan model.gamma * p09ComplexRms run.input + forward.secondOrderCoeff * model.epsilon^2 / Real.sqrt n and p09ComplexMax delta <= model.epsilon * Real.sqrt n * p09K plan model.gamma * p09ComplexRms run.input + forward.secondOrderCoeff * model.epsilon^2
formal_statement.plain_language: The exact roundoff error of a linked mixed-radix complex FFT is the exact Fourier transform of a fictional input perturbation whose RMS norm has the paper's exact scaling and whose RMS and maximum norms satisfy Ramos's two epsilon-K bounds with explicit second-order remainders.

informal_proof: Use surjectivity of the fixed complex DFT to choose delta with T delta=e. The exact unnormalized Fourier RMS scaling gives ||delta||RMS=||e||RMS/sqrt(N). Divide the inherited Theorem 1 RMS certificate by sqrt(N) for the first bound. For the second, combine ||delta||infinity<=||delta||2=sqrt(N)||delta||RMS=||e||RMS with that same inherited certificate.
informal_statement: The exact fictional-input backward-error construction and both norm certificates on printed page 768, tied to the paper's complex mixed-radix FFT and with each O(epsilon^2) term exposed finitely.
